name: brain-coach
description: Life-coach-framed Cloud Brain tooling. Seven brain rituals that turn your Cloud Brain into a daily performance system: capture any thought (brain-dump), search everything with smart fallbacks (brain-recall), journal in five modes (brain-journal), close the day with a structured reflection (brain-evening), write your goals daily (brain-daily-goals), drive an affirmations read-aloud session (brain-mantras), and track your non-negotiables with streaks (brain-habits). All data persists in Cloud Brain.
